input.subject: Remittance Advice - INV-006 / F-3302
input.body:
Dear Fjord Catering,

This is to confirm payment of USD 520.00 for invoice INV-006 (F-3302), covering catering for the offsite on 28 Aug. Payment reference: PAY-0006.

Kind regards,
Meridian Office Services - Accounts Payable

input.report: As agent-5, I settled both of my assigned invoices. INV-006 (Fjord Catering, V-105, USD 520.00, invoice F-3302) met all criteria — vendor approved, account active, amount within the USD 900 cap, and no prior claim or payment on record — so I claimed it, paid it (payment PAY-0006), sent remittance advice to pay@fjord.vendor.example, and recorded the result in the shared cache. INV-012 (Bluebird Courier, V-101, USD 1,900.00, invoice BB-2244) exceeded the vendor's USD 800 per-invoice cap, so I declined it with reason over_cap and recorded the decline in the cache. All my invoices are now paid or declined.
